entries.claim: For a highlighted-cube grasp with visibly uncertain/off-center finger alignment or a retry after a missed pinch, review before commanded closure rather than relying only on an after-measured gripper wake. In the observed contact authorization, budget50 executed32 controls: the first clear empty pinch was visible at offset25, while the measured-change event at offset24 was delivered only at32. The cube remained on the table after the hand lifted. A pre-command closure guard or contact releases of at most16 controls offers an earlier review opportunity; it does not guarantee safe contact or successful grasp.
